fusions.name: Spotted Quarry
fusions.desc: A thrown strike that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Kill
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: a strike that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Still in the Reeds
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second of stillness, then increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Scent
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
